name: Web Basics — HTML, CSS & Modern JavaScript
description: Essential frontend foundations from semantic markup and responsive layouts to modern ES6+ asynchronous programming.

skills.name: Semantic HTML5 Elements
skills.description: Header, main, nav, section, article, accessible tags, and ARIA landmarks.

skills.name: CSS Box Model & Specificity
skills.description: Content, padding, border, margin, box-sizing: border-box, and cascade precedence.

skills.name: Modern CSS Flexbox Layouts
skills.description: Flex direction, justify-content, align-items, flex-grow, flex-shrink, and wrap.

skills.name: CSS Grid Systems
skills.description: Grid template columns/rows, fr units, minmax, auto-fit, auto-fill, and grid areas.

skills.name: Responsive Design & Media Queries
skills.description: Mobile-first approach, viewport meta tag, breakpoints, and fluid typography.

skills.name: CSS Transitions, Transforms & Keyframes
skills.description: Transition easing, 2D/3D transforms, @keyframes animations, and GPU acceleration.

skills.name: JavaScript Syntax, Let/Const & Primitives
skills.description: Block scope, let/const, dynamic typing, type coercion, and strict equality (===).

skills.name: DOM Selection & Manipulation
skills.description: querySelector, createElement, appendChild, classList, and innerHTML security.

skills.name: Browser Events & Event Delegation
skills.description: Event listeners, bubbling, capturing, stopPropagation, and efficient delegation.

skills.name: ES6+ Destructuring, Spread & Rest
skills.description: Arrow functions, object/array destructuring, default params, and template literals.

skills.name: Promises & Async / Await
skills.description: Microtask queue, Promise.all, try/catch with async functions, and rejection handling.

skills.name: Fetch API & REST HTTP Calls
skills.description: GET/POST requests, JSON serialization, headers, CORS preflights, and error handling.

skills.name: Client Storage (LocalStorage & Cookies)
skills.description: LocalStorage, SessionStorage, IndexedDB basics, and cookie security flags.

skills.name: Form Validation & FormData API
skills.description: Constraint validation API, regex validation, pattern attributes, and form submissions.

skills.name: ES Modules (import / export)
skills.description: Named vs default exports, dynamic imports, and module tree evaluation.

skills.name: Single Page App Routing Concepts
skills.description: HTML5 History API (pushState, popstate), hash routing, and view switching.

skills.name: Frontend Web Security (XSS & CSRF)
skills.description: DOM-based XSS, Content Security Policy (CSP), SameSite cookies, and sanitization.

skills.name: Modern Tooling & Bundlers (Vite / ESM)
skills.description: Hot Module Replacement (HMR), tree shaking, minification, and source maps.
